address: Kettelerallee 72, Frankfurt on the Main, 60385, Germany
bio: A fantastic concept showcasing regional cuisine at outstanding value for money. The kitchen takes its cue from the changing seasons, and the menu provides information about the restaurant's nose-to-tail approach and the provenance of the ingredients. The dishes change daily according to availability and are only revealed when the restaurant opens at 5pm. Many items are so popular that they appear time and again, such as Odenwälder Handkäse (a traditional Odenwald soft cheese) or a delicious pâté. The inviting tavern-style interior and very friendly service create a charming atmosphere in which to savour good food.
